title: Cancellation and hold
summary: Host abort retains custody until the interrupted case records starting_state_restore: restored=true for its baseline, or a no-restore receipt for as_is. Removed missions finish through walk-end. Cleanup finish always releases its lease; absent or false restoration records reset_owed for that baseline, defaulting to fresh-host. The next holder resets before any case or mission, including as_is. Failed recovery records machine_needs_repair and the reset command in evidence and steering. A later successful reset clears debt. Source tests are not deployed proof.
